title: A word from our
quote: Welcome to Ingeri International School, a school founded on the belief that every child is unique and deserves a warm, caring, and nurturing environment. Rooted in Christian values, our school welcomes families from all backgrounds and faiths, united by a shared desire to see every child thrive in an environment filled with love, respect, and faith.
p1: Welcome to Ingeri International School, a school founded on the belief that every child is unique and deserves a warm, caring, and nurturing environment. Rooted in Christian values, our school welcomes families from all backgrounds and faiths, united by a shared desire to see every child thrive in an environment filled with love, respect, and faith.
p2: From daycare to preschool, we nurture our students’curiosity, creativity, and independence through play, exploration, and meaningful relationships with others. At Ingeri, our hallways are filled with laughter, joyful play, and cheerful songs, where every child discovers their unique worth and their ability to love and serve the world around them.
p3: Believing that education is built hand in hand with families, we look forward to welcoming you into the Ingeri family!
name: Gaelle Rubagenga
